chunks.text: Hermes Agent discovers web providers through the WebSearchProvider interface. A provider reports supports_search and supports_extract, and search returns the Hermes web result envelope with title, URL, description, and position.
SupraCrawl uses OpenSearch BM25 lexical ranking over chunk title, heading section path, and body text. Title and heading fields receive boosts while the best matching chunk represents each document.

title: Redis extraction cache and TTL behavior

chunks.text: The extraction cache stores JSON responses in Redis with a configurable TTL. Cache failures are non-fatal so extraction can continue when Redis is unavailable, and force refresh bypasses a cached document.

Static HTTP fetching is attempted first. Playwright and Chromium are used only when a page requires JavaScript rendering or static extraction has insufficient useful content. Browser subrequests are filtered through URL safety checks.

Public URL validation blocks localhost, loopback, private LAN ranges, link-local addresses, cloud metadata hosts, reserved networks, and unsafe redirect targets. DNS resolution is checked before outbound HTTP requests.

SupraCrawl reads robots.txt using the configured crawler user agent. Network failures and server errors are handled conservatively with fail-closed behavior, and oversized robots responses are rejected.

The local stack contains the SupraCrawl FastAPI service, the Readability and Playwright extraction worker, Redis, and OpenSearch. OpenSearch publishes its development port on the loopback interface only.

Concurrent refreshes of the same document are serialized with an asyncio lock keyed by document identity. Different documents can still index concurrently, preventing one reindex operation from deleting another operation's new chunks.
La búsqueda léxica de SupraCrawl usa BM25 en OpenSearch sobre el título, la ruta de encabezados y el texto de cada fragmento. Los resultados se agrupan por documento para evitar páginas duplicadas.

El extractor elimina scripts, estilos, navegación y otros elementos de ruido antes de producir Markdown limpio. Readability es la ruta principal y Trafilatura funciona como respaldo cuando la extracción principal no entrega contenido útil.

title: Multilingual dense embeddings for semantic retrieval

chunks.text: Models such as multilingual-E5-small and BGE-M3 produce dense vector embeddings for semantic retrieval across languages. Dense retrieval can recover conceptually related passages even when query and document use different vocabulary.

title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion for hybrid retrieval

chunks.text: Reciprocal Rank Fusion combines lexical and dense ranked lists using reciprocal rank positions. RRF does not require learned fusion weights or model training and is a robust baseline for hybrid search.

A production retrieval service should report request counts, error rates, p50 and p95 latency, index freshness, result counts, and context size. OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana can provide operational visibility.
PostgreSQL is useful for transactional relational records, constraints, and SQL joins. It is not the lexical search engine used by the current SupraCrawl BM25 retrieval baseline.

title: Collapse search hits by document identity

chunks.text: OpenSearch search requests collapse chunk hits on the document_id keyword field. This guarantees that many matching chunks from one page cannot occupy multiple result positions in the final web search list.

After writing the current document and chunk content hash, the indexer runs delete_by_query for the same document_id while excluding the new content hash. Old stale chunks are therefore removed after a successful reindex.
